description: Use this when the user wants to connect a service to Apptiller: App Store Connect, an ad account, an attribution tool, RevenueCat, Stripe or Google Search Console. Returns a one-time link (valid 15 minutes) that the user opens in a browser to connect a service to Apptiller. The user enters any keys or passwords on that page, not in the chat.
